regional-analysis-three-kinds.alt: Three panels. A formal region shares one trait, drawn as one evenly shaded area, for example where most people speak French. A functional region is organized around a center, drawn as lines from a center to many points, for example a newspaper's delivery area. A perceptual region is what people believe, drawn as two overlapping dashed outlines that do not agree, for example "the South" in the United States.
